verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is a professional workstation GPU, not an agent or software application that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the card or its first-party software shipping an MCP client capability. Mentions of running AI agents locally describe workloads the hardware accelerates, not tool-calling integration by the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
